PLAN "Pregnancy Strength Maintenance"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Maintain strength and functional capacity through pregnancy"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1: Weeks 1–4" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Lower Body A":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          split_squat 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x12..15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          calf_raise 3x12..15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 90s
          hip_flexor_stretch 90s
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Upper Body A":
        warmup:
          arm_circles 2m
        main straight_sets:
          dumbbell_press 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          lateral_raise 3x10..12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 90s
          shoulder_stretch 90s
      DAY Friday training 50m "Lower Body B":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          front_squat 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          leg_press 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          leg_curl 3x10..12 rpe 5 rest 75 seconds
